tob-0038-d4: Church Committee Book IV gives more staff reports on foreign and military intelligence — deep backup for the main findings. Its detailed case studies lay secret operations bare one by one. The files speak for themselves. The volume serves students of spy history.
tob-0039-d4: This roll keeps another slice of the Doctors’ Trial record — the 1946-47 Nuremberg case against Nazi doctors for cruel experiments. The court record holds questions, answers, and the final judgment. Historians use it to trace the trial day by day.
